Description: Demolition of existing single-story structures on-site, construction of a new 8,450 square-foot mixed-use building, providing 12 parking spaces, 12 artist studios, R&D space, a fabrication shop, art gallery and one live/work unit.

Description: demolition of an existing non-residential building on a 12,800 square-foot industrial parcel and construction of a three-story, 20,390 square-foot mixed-use building with two Live/Work Units containing Art/Craft Studio workspaces, 12 Art/Craft Studios, a Research and Development facility (2,018 square feet), Light Manufacturing (shared fabrication shop) (2,616 square feet), and Incidental Retail (art gallery) (1,984 square feet), as well as a parking garage for 10 vehicles and 24 bicycles at the ground level.
